I want to make a conscious effort to prioritize my breaks and take care of myself today, so I can maintain my focus and productivity. I'll try to schedule some time for relaxation and recharge.

Her support means a lot to me right now, and I need to focus on my work, but also prioritize my well-being to recharge and meet the deadline for the Cipher Corp Customer Portal.
